explanation: This fires only at D1 when the previous trial went unrewarded, and only near the end of the episode (about trial 92 onward), where it usually reaches 8-10; it sometimes drops to 0 on the second loss in a row. Everything else stays at 0: every GO and D2 step, every D1 after a rewarded trial (at most 1 late in the episode), and every D1 after a loss before about trial 90 (at most 1).
